summary: Brookfield Property Partners filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, announcing the declaration of quarterly dividends on its listed preferred units. The Board of Directors declared distributions on the Class A Nasdaq-listed BPYPP, BPYPO, BPYPN, and BPYPM preferred units of $0.40625, $0.3984375, $0.359375, and $0.390625 per unit, respectively, payable on September 29, 2026, to holders of record on September 1, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation such as a restructuring, capital return initiative, or strategic event. No structural changes, premiums, or deal terms are involved.
